name: Trap Resort
source:
Welcome to Paradise… or Disaster?
You’ve just inherited a run-down tropical resort, but there’s a catch—your entire staff consists of three drop-dead gorgeous traps who are more than eager to make your stay… exciting.
With no guests, no money, and more sexual tension than a broken air conditioner in July, it’s up to you to turn this resort into a five-star paradise while navigating the teasing, chaos, and unexpected romantic encounters with your alluring employees.
Will you run a successful business… or will you spend your days drowning in temptation?
